Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.wg

Class Toolkit3D

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.wg.Toolkit3D
public final class Toolkit3D extends Object
This class is analogous to those of AWT's Toolkit and used to obtain properties related to LG3D graphics rendering.

    • getFieldOfView

      public float getFieldOfView(float width)
      Returns the field of view of the universe (in terms of screen width). Calculate the result using the givin width. This method is used when object's position need to be changed to new position before the screen size if fully updated.

      float the field of view of the universe
